name: Datadog MCP
tagline: Query metrics, logs, and traces from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The official Datadog MCP server. Query metrics, search logs, inspect traces, list monitors, and check SLOs. The canonical way to give an agent observability access.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Datadog MCP server, maintained by Datadog. Exposes the Datadog API as MCP tools: query metrics (CPU, memory, request rate, latency, custom), search logs with filters, fetch traces, list active monitors, check SLO status, and create incidents.

## Why we recommend it

If your production stack is on Datadog, this is the cleanest way to let your agent help with debugging and operations. "Why is API latency p99 3 seconds right now?" becomes a one-question ask. The auth is your standard Datadog API key with whatever scopes you grant.

## When to use it

- SRE agents that help debug production incidents
- On-call assistance: agent pulls recent errors, latency spikes, deployment changes
- Cost analysis: agent identifies high-cost services or unused metrics
- Custom dashboards: agent queries the data and generates a one-off report
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key and App key at https://app.datadoghq.com/organization-settings/application-keys
2. Set: `DATADOG_API_KEY`, `DATADOG_APP_KEY`, `DATADOG_SITE` (e.g., `datadoghq.com`)
3. `uvx mcp-server-datadog`

**Security note:** Use a key scoped to the specific resources the agent needs. Datadog's audit log shows all agent activity.
pricingDetails: Free. Datadog charges per host, per ingested event, etc. The MCP server itself is open source.
